fabric.boundary: Conceptual communication paths. Illustrative topology, queue cells and timing; independent of the recorded FIFO model. No GPU or NIC measurement.

modes.name: Incast
modes.note: Three senders converge on one receiver. Arrival synchronization becomes visible.

modes.name: Congestion
modes.note: A shared receiver queue fills; the next illustrative arrival cannot be accepted.

modes.name: Alternate path
modes.note: Traffic uses another link. A different path cannot remove a shared receiver bottleneck.

modes.name: Collective
modes.note: Scatter → local work → reduce → synchronize. A conceptual sequence, not an NCCL algorithm or benchmark.

memory.boundary: Conceptual memory geography. Proximity and transfer boundaries, without latency values or a universal hardware ordering.

modes.name: Load model
modes.note: A persisted model is staged through host memory and transferred to device memory.

modes.name: Local work
modes.note: An illustrative operand path approaches execution. Real cache behavior depends on the workload.

modes.name: Host transfer
modes.note: Crossing a device boundary creates data movement. This diagram assigns no latency.
